# Public synthetic document-inspection fixtures

Original public attachments from [Issue #482](https://github.com/flyfish-dev/file-viewer/issues/482), retained without rewriting:

- `demo-pades-self-signed.pdf`: SHA256 `78e18876926fcd83e82ff248eb5f13bb9b3a6f843ce00de8dbfbfd941b4c6f52`.
- `demo-jades-self-signed.json`: SHA256 `e5317622deda9ffe8fb0f390b9fece606f8bce983f8efd2aab400abcb616ae31`.
- `demo-xades-self-signed.xml`: SHA256 `8423bee6cac7fbbe6d1ecbaff24f515d2b7292992b9d2d2407ab9572bdf0be56`.

The issue's contributor supplies the synthetic content under CC0-1.0. The original PDF retains its embedded permissive font notices. These are self-signed metadata fixtures, not trusted identities, valid-profile certificates, or proof of ETSI conformance. No private keys are included. Additional multiple-signature, incremental-update and malformed-input cases are constructed by the focused tests.
